text: Ah! There they are! My new security team! Martin Bixby. Marty to my friends. Mr. Bixby to anybody I owe money to.
Take a look at that, huh? Beautiful, ain't it? Trees! Fresh air! Waterfront property! And not a single happy camper for miles. Heh! [chuckles]
Lemme tell ya somethin'. You know what I paid for this place?
Actually, forget it. I tell you that, you're gonna start askin' me for a raise.

Here's the deal. I bought this whole property. Cabins, dining hall, recreation center, the whole nine yards. Now, the plan is simple. Tear it all down, clear out the junk, and turn this place into something that actually MAKES money.
Problem is, apparently everybody and their grandmother wants a piece of Camp Ashwood.
I'm talkin' teenagers, ghost hunters, people with cameras... idiots! Last month somebody broke into one of the cabins and stole a toilet! A TOILET! Who the hell steals a twenty-year-old toilet?!
Ah, whatever. People are nuts.

Anyway, the place has been shut down for years. There was some bad business back then. Made the papers. Whole big thing. Now everybody thinks they're gonna find some priceless piece of history in there. Well, lemme tell ya, the only thing they're gonna find is mold and a lawsuit.

So, that's where you come in. I need somebody keeping an eye on things while we get ready for demolition. Walk the property, make sure nobody's breaking in, and if you find something busted, patch it up. Nothing complicated.

See those cabins over there? Security office is out back, near Cabin Six. Once you get off the dock, follow the main path toward the cabin grounds. You can't miss it. Little wooden building, looks like it lost a fight with a lawnmower.
There's a map inside. Flashlights. Some equipment. Walkie-talkies, too. Grab yourselves a radio and switch it over to channel two. I'll be on the other end. Lucky you, huh?
Oh, and you might have to get the generator running. Power's been a little... temperamental. Maintenance shed's got everything you should need.
One more thing.
[serious] Don't go wandering too far into the woods. There's some old trails back there. Easy to get turned around, especially in the dark. And I am NOT paying for a search party.
Other than that? Piece of cake! Keep the place standing until I can knock it down, and everybody gets paid.
All right! This is your stop. Welcome to Camp Ashwood!
...Better you than me. [chuckles]
Oh, the gate up the dock's got a chain on it. Just lift the chain off and swing it open. Locks are for people with something worth stealing.
Now get moving. Night ain't getting any shorter!
